description: Emergency Spotify Android 9.1.80.2221 ARM64/APKM playback-safety preview. The experimental audio slot disabler is reset to OFF on first startup, native stream/preroll ad slots are explicitly restored, and the original ad slot override remains available only if intentionally re-enabled. Does not address other causes of skipping. Does not include the experimental Premium popup blocker or Shuffle probes. Source: https://github.com/NasiGoRank/morphe-spicetify-patches/tree/hotfix/audio-ad-playback-safety
